mdxtab.preview.markdownIt.enabled.description: Enable MDXTab rendering in the built-in Markdown preview using a Markdown-It plugin.

mdxtab.preview.showFrontmatter.description: Show frontmatter and formulas in the MDXTab preview. Disable to hide formulas/frontmatter so only the rendered markdown body is shown.

mdxtab.preview.showComputedColumns.description: Show computed columns in preview tables. When enabled, empty cells for authored computed columns are filled with evaluated values, and computed columns not in the source table are appended.

mdxtab.preview.showSummaryRows.description: Show summary rows in preview tables. When enabled, synthetic rows defined via summary_rows in frontmatter are appended at the bottom of the table.

mdxtab.limits.maxExpressionLength.description: Maximum expression length in characters before MDXTab reports E_LIMIT. Applies to validation and preview rendering.

mdxtab.limits.maxTokens.description: Maximum token count per expression before MDXTab reports E_LIMIT. Applies to validation and preview rendering.

mdxtab.limits.maxAstDepth.description: Maximum measured AST depth per expression before MDXTab reports E_LIMIT. Applies to validation and preview rendering.

mdxtab.limits.maxParseDepth.description: Maximum parser nesting depth per expression before MDXTab reports E_LIMIT. Applies to validation and preview rendering.

mdxtab.limits.maxDependencyDepth.description: Maximum dependency traversal depth before MDXTab reports E_LIMIT. Applies to validation and preview rendering.

scripts.build: npm run -w @mdxtab/core build --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node ./scripts/copy-core.mjs
